title: Opened GreyCTF 2026 registration page in Chrome

ai_analysis.summary: The user requested to open the GreyCTF 2026 registration page in Chrome. The assistant located the registration URL from CTFtime and opened it in the Chrome browser using a plugin.

steps.text: Identified user request to open registration page.
Located current registration URL from CTFtime.
Used Computer Use plugin to open URL in Chrome.
